purpose: generate a compile-time sparse heterogeneous-width bank router from bank_config_pkg without a full all-bank all-port crossbar

package.name: bank_config_pkg
package.source_basis: user supplied config_pkg bank inventory and role lists
required_changes_from_source_basis: set BANK_READ_LATENCY to 3 to match current bram_bank and uram_bank contracts
add active-bank and role-capability query functions without changing the supplied bank inventory or role lists

bank_inventory.inactive_banks: 4 through 15 are BANK_NONE and illegal request targets

physical_interface_rule: use explicit named bank0 through bank3 physical ports at each bank's exact width; a MAX_BANK_WIDTH packed array is forbidden at the router boundary
physical_connections: MM2S write decodes only to bank0 bank1 or bank2
SA_ACT read connects directly to bank1
SA_WGT read connects directly to bank2
SA_OUT write connects directly to bank3
SA_OUT read and S2MM read share only bank3 read port under mutually exclusive ownership
bank0 has no read consumer in this revision

request_protocol.write: valid_ready; accept one word on valid and ready
request_protocol.read: valid_ready request and fixed response exactly BANK_READ_LATENCY cycles later
request_protocol.ownership: request requires active configured bank, role capability, bank_busy, and matching bank_owner_port

fault_policy.behavior: denied request never enables a physical bank and latches first fault until reset

required_cases: package inventory and role lists exactly match the frozen contract
MM2S writes banks 0 1 and 2 and cannot write bank3 or BANK_NONE
SA_ACT reads only bank1 at 256 bits after latency 3
SA_WGT reads only bank2 at 128 bits after latency 3
SA_OUT reads and writes bank3 at 1024 bits
S2MM reads only bank3 at 1024 bits
SA_OUT and S2MM bank3 read collision is blocked
wrong owner and free bank requests produce no physical enable
reset flushes response-valid pipelines and sticky fault
OOC utilization is compared against full router baseline 7053 LUT and 95 FF
